items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: got Doc's head around there, you see.

ctx.x: You know Crowback, huh? No. Crowback is the one who tried to be white on the side, you know. And he figured if he'd get to go out there, white boy, and he'd talk just like a white boy, you know. Hey, you guys, you know what I'm singing this? Say, because you guys give me a shot, damn pen with them guys up there, you know. And he wouldn't say he was a white boy, you know, but he was a father, he tried to pass my wife, you know. The real big guy, he never did try. No. The real big guy go down and the white boy…
He hit him up. He got a student there going in.
